name: Kajabi
summary: Platform for online courses and memberships.

flows.title: Filter contacts and save the filter as a Segment
steps: From your Dashboard, open the Contacts tab.
Select a Category, a Conditional and a Value — for example Tags, Has all, and the Tag names to match.
To narrow the results further, click Add filter and build another one. Up to 10 filters apply at a time.
Once the filters are applied, Save as Segment appears above the contact list, next to the filter count. Click it to save the current set of filters and reuse it later.

flows.title: Add a tag to a contact
steps: Open the Contacts tab from the Dashboard.
Select the name of the contact you want to view.
Open the dropdown menu to create a tag or choose an existing one. A site can hold up to 100 tags in total.
Click Save to keep and apply your changes.
